figurative_meaning_en: Hatred, envy, and similar malicious mental attitudes
example_sentences_in_bangla: তার মনে বিষ জমে আছে, তাই সবাইকে কষ্ট দেয়।
এই রাজনীতিতে অনেকের মনে বিষ দেখা যায়।
example_sentences_in_english: He has poison in his mind, so he hurts everyone.
In this politics, poison is seen in many people's minds.
note: The idiom draws from the metaphor of poison representing toxic thoughts, common in Bengali expressive language.
